body:
I am not sure I follow you. We need to search "foo" in fields A,B,C and "bar" in fields B,C,D. We must _not_ match "foo" in field D and "bar" in field A.

How I understand things is that if you want to be able to have ranked results and correct pagination server side:
*  you must use only one request
* to match those fields you need to use the `query` (those are not facets)
* a single query means a single set of fields to match from.

Am I missing something here?
